scheme_name: Financial Assistance for Medical Treatment of Journalists
other_conditions: Full‑time journalist with at least 5 years of work experience
Application must be submitted within three months of undergoing medical treatment
Treatment must be conducted in hospitals recognized by the Tamil Nadu State Hospital Organization
Retired journalists receiving a government pension are eligible but will receive only 50 % of the financial assistance
benefits_summary: Provides a financial assistance of up to ₹50,000 for medical treatment of journalists.
